name: calendar-sync
description: Reads your calendar (private iCal link) so notifications and questions respect meetings and time off, and suggests slots for long jobs.

icsUrl.title: Private iCal (ICS) address
icsUrl.description: Google: calendar settings > Secret address in iCal format. Outlook: Publish calendar (ICS link). Apple: Public calendar link. Treat it like a password.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the calendar is read again (all sessions share one copy).

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA zone for all-day events, floating times and working hours, e.g. Europe/Rome. Empty: this machine's zone.

workHours.title: Working hours
workHours.description: Free slots are offered inside these hours, HH:MM-HH:MM.

workDays.title: Working days
workDays.description: Days free slots are offered on: mon-fri, or a list like mon,tue,thu.

minSlotMinutes.title: Shortest free slot (minutes)
minSlotMinutes.description: Shorter gaps are not listed as free time.

meetingPresence.title: Meetings make me away
meetingPresence.description: While you are in a meeting, tell the hub you are away (needs mods-hub).

outOfOffice.title: Time off holds notifications
outOfOffice.description: Out-of-office or vacation events put the hub in a Night-like hold: only critical notices reach your channels (needs mods-hub).

offKeywords.title: Extra out-of-office words
offKeywords.description: Comma separated words that make an event count as time off, besides vacation, ferie, out of office, PTO, holiday, sick, urlaub...

myEmail.title: Your email address
myEmail.description: Events you declined (matched on this address) are ignored. Optional.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show 'In a meeting until 15:00' or 'Next in 20m: Standup' in the status line.
